text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today to $142.37, continuing a sharp four-day rally that has added nearly $6 to the stock's price. The move comes as crude oil prices have stabilized and edged higher — US oil is trading around $89.62 per barrel — following earlier weakness tied to hopes for an Iran peace deal and signs of global oil oversupply. After dipping below $90 just three days ago on ceasefire optimism, the market appears to be repricing oil prices upward as those hopes fade and supply concerns ease.

The broader context: Russia's crude production has rebounded to 8.73 million barrels per day, pushing global markets into surplus, but oil prices have still held relatively firm despite that headwind. The stock's recovery over the past week suggests investors are betting that any near-term geopolitical relief rally has run its course, and that oil will trade on fundamentals — which currently include solid global demand and a stabilizing price floor.
